description: Returns a plain-language preview of a valid ConsoleMouse profile: for a derived profile one sentence per change against its base (keys, macros, press once, mouse movement), for a full profile one sentence per key. Languages: de, en, es, fr, it, pl, pt-BR. Read-only.

profile.description: The profile as a JSON object, as JSON text, an import envelope, or an import code (CMP2., or the older CM1.). Usually a derived profile (origin "derived", base_profile_id, patch).

name: profile_describe
title: Describe a ConsoleMouse profile in plain words
